scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: RERENDER QUEUED (pass 4 needed). Four attempts. Pass 1 read six-limbed; pass 2 fixed the legs but kept a floor-length cloak and a bald crown; pass 3 fixed the elder completely and the limbs read correctly, but the pose rotated the animal almost side-on and the folded wing wrist rendered as a pointed GOLDEN BEAK with the snout suppressed - bird anatomy, a hard fail against the reptilian lock. Ground in passes 2-3 also drifted pale grey. Next pass must rotate back toward the wing-shoulder-out-of-frame framing, make the wing joint a blunt rounded scaled knuckle with no hook or point, and state "reptile not bird / no beak / no hooked bill" in the subject text.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: Approved on pass 3. Fully interior: no sky, no daylight, no green hills; ledge is raw fractured basalt, not coursed masonry; no flame of any kind. Long crocodilian skull, twin obsidian horns, one folded wing, four limbs. Pass 2 had produced a literal column of fire behind the animal, which is a hard fail.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs

The pale columnar rock of the ledge is natural jointing, not masonry.
